fr.title: Unique Patient Registration
fr.statement: When a patient submits required account details, the system shall create one patient account if the contact identifier is unique.
fr.accept: Accept valid unique registration; do not create a duplicate account

fr.title: Validate Registration Details
fr.statement: When patient registration data are incomplete or duplicated, the system shall reject the submission and identify invalid fields.
fr.accept: No new account is created with incomplete or duplicate registration details

fr.title: Role-Based Sign-In
fr.statement: When an existing user supplies valid credentials, the system shall create an authenticated session for the matching role.
fr.accept: Valid credentials create a session; invalid credentials do not

fr.title: View Own Profile
fr.statement: When a patient views the profile, the system shall display their registered non-sensitive profile fields.
fr.accept: Patient A cannot view patient B’s personal profile

fr.title: Update Own Profile
fr.statement: When a patient edits a permitted profile field, the system shall validate and persist it or preserve the previous value on failure.
fr.accept: Valid updates persist; invalid updates preserve original values

fr.title: Search by Specialty
fr.statement: When a patient selects a specialty, the system shall list doctors assigned to that specialty.
fr.accept: Only doctors assigned to the selected specialty are returned

fr.title: Show Available Slots
fr.statement: When a date and doctor are selected, the system shall show only non-suspended future appointment slots with remaining capacity.
fr.accept: Past, suspended and fully booked slots are excluded

fr.title: Handle Unavailable Schedules
fr.statement: If no eligible slot exists for the selected day, the system shall display an empty-result message and permit choosing another date.
fr.accept: Show an empty result message without creating a booking

fr.title: Create Appointment
fr.statement: When a patient confirms an available slot, the system shall create an appointment with a unique ID and status Confirmed.
fr.accept: A unique appointment ID and Confirmed status are created

fr.title: Prevent Overbooking
fr.statement: While concurrent booking requests compete for a slot, the system shall prevent confirmed bookings from exceeding slot capacity.
fr.accept: With capacity = 1, only one of two competing confirmations succeeds

fr.title: Reject Ineligible Slot
fr.statement: If a slot is unavailable at confirmation time, the system shall reject booking without reducing its remaining capacity.
fr.accept: No appointment is created or capacity consumed for an invalid slot

fr.title: List My Appointments
fr.statement: When an authenticated patient opens My Appointments, the system shall list only appointments owned by that patient.
fr.accept: No other patient’s appointment appears in the response

fr.title: Display Appointment Details
fr.statement: When a patient opens an owned appointment, the system shall display appointment ID, specialty, doctor, time and status.
fr.accept: Appointment ID, specialty, doctor, time and status are displayed

fr.title: Cancel Within Allowed Window
fr.statement: When an appointment owner cancels at least 12 hours before the visit, the system shall set status Cancelled and release the occupied slot once.
fr.accept: Status becomes Cancelled and capacity is released exactly once

fr.title: Block Late or Unauthorized Cancellation
fr.statement: If cancellation is requested within 12 hours of the visit or the appointment is not owned by the requester, the system shall reject self-service cancellation.
fr.accept: Confirmed status and remaining capacity remain unchanged

fr.title: Atomic Appointment Rescheduling
fr.statement: When an appointment owner selects an eligible new slot at least 12 hours before the visit, the system shall atomically move the booking to the new slot.
fr.accept: Original slot is released and the new slot is reserved exactly once

fr.title: Preserve Booking on Rescheduling Failure
fr.statement: If a reschedule request fails eligibility or availability checks, the system shall preserve the original appointment and slot allocation.
fr.accept: No original booking is lost and no new capacity is consumed

fr.title: Validate Reception Check-in
fr.statement: When reception staff provide a valid Confirmed appointment ID and verify patient identity, the system shall set the appointment status to Checked-in.
fr.accept: Confirmed transitions to Checked-in after identity verification

fr.title: Prevent Duplicate Check-in
fr.statement: If an appointment is already Checked-in, Cancelled or unknown, the system shall reject an additional check-in without changing the record.
fr.accept: A second check-in record is never created

fr.title: View Assigned Doctor Queue
fr.statement: When an assigned doctor requests their daily queue, the system shall display only appointments for that doctor and day.
fr.accept: Doctor can view only assigned appointments

fr.title: Start Consultation
fr.statement: When an assigned doctor begins a Checked-in appointment, the system shall transition it to In Progress.
fr.accept: Only Checked-in appointments can transition to In Progress

fr.title: Complete Consultation
fr.statement: When an assigned doctor finishes an In Progress appointment, the system shall set status Completed.
fr.accept: Only In Progress appointments can transition to Completed

fr.title: Prevent Overlapping Physician Slots
fr.statement: When an administrator creates a doctor slot, the system shall reject overlapping active slots for that doctor.
fr.accept: Overlapping active slots cannot be created for the same doctor

fr.title: Handle Unexpected Physician Absence
fr.statement: When an administrator suspends a doctor slot with confirmed patients, the system shall flag its affected appointments Needs Rescheduling for staff action.
fr.accept: Every affected booking is flagged for staff review

fr.title: Audit Schedule Changes
fr.statement: When an administrator changes a schedule, the system shall record the actor, time and before/after values in the audit log.
fr.accept: Audit entry contains actor, timestamp, previous and new values

fr.title: Enqueue Notification Events
fr.statement: When an appointment is confirmed, cancelled or rescheduled, the system shall enqueue exactly one logical notification event for that action.
fr.accept: One logical event with a unique event ID is created per relevant action

fr.title: Preserve Appointment During Notification Failure
fr.statement: If a notification provider returns an error, the system shall retain the appointment state and mark the event for a controlled retry.
fr.accept: The appointment does not change; failed events are marked for retry

fr.title: Count Appointments by Status
fr.statement: When an administrator requests a daily summary, the system shall return counts of Confirmed, Checked-in, Completed, Cancelled and No-show appointments.
fr.accept: Status totals match the underlying appointment records

fr.title: Retrieve Audit Records
fr.statement: When an authorized administrator requests an audit record, the system shall display the event actor, action and timestamp.
fr.accept: Audit record includes actor, action and timestamp

fr.title: Restrict Administrative Reports
fr.statement: If a non-administrator requests a restricted report, the system shall deny access without returning the report contents.
fr.accept: Unauthorized users receive access denied with no report contents

nfr.statement: During a load test with 200 concurrent sessions, at least 95% of available-slot searches shall respond within 3 seconds.
At 100 booking requests per minute, at least 95% of confirmations shall finish within 5 seconds.
With 100 concurrent requests for a slot with capacity 1, the system shall create no more than one Confirmed booking.
For 100% of simulated rescheduling transaction failures, the original appointment and its slot allocation shall remain intact.
Every request to read or modify private bookings shall check ownership or authorized staff role.
All personal data transmitted through web interfaces shall be protected with TLS version 1.2 or above.
Target monthly system availability shall be at least 99.5%, excluding announced maintenance.
In a usability test of ten new users, at least nine shall independently complete a booking within five minutes.
Every successful create, cancel, reschedule or physician schedule update shall produce an audit entry.
When the notification provider fails, all valid Confirmed bookings shall remain and a retryable event shall be stored.

br.rule: Contact identifiers must be unique and every authenticated session has an assigned role.
A slot is eligible only if it is in the future, active and has booking_count below capacity.
A Confirmed appointment can be created only after a final capacity check at commit time.
Patients may self-cancel at least 12 hours before the visit; authorized staff handle exceptions.
Patients may self-reschedule at least 12 hours before the visit; both slot allocations change atomically.
Only a Confirmed appointment may be checked in, and only once.
Doctors may view and update only visits assigned to them.
Overlapping active time slots may not be configured for the same doctor.
An unexpected physician absence flags affected visits as Needs Rescheduling; it does not reassign another doctor automatically.
Private appointment information may be read only by the owner or an authorized staff member.
Schedule and appointment state changes must be recorded in an audit log.
A notification failure must not destroy a booking; every logical event has a unique event_id.

scenarios.title: Successful Appointment Booking
scenarios.story: The patient selects Gastroenterology, a doctor and the available 09:00 slot; a Confirmed appointment with a code is created.

scenarios.title: Concurrent Requests for the Last Place
scenarios.story: Two patients attempt to reserve the same last place; exactly one booking succeeds.

scenarios.title: No Appointment Slots Available
scenarios.story: The system reports that no place remains and suggests an alternative date without creating an invalid booking.

scenarios.title: Cancellation Before the Deadline
scenarios.story: The patient cancels at least 12 hours in advance; exactly one place is released.

scenarios.title: Late Cancellation Attempt
scenarios.story: With only three hours remaining, self-service cancellation is denied and the patient is referred to reception.

scenarios.title: Successful Appointment Rescheduling
scenarios.story: The original slot is released and a new slot reserved within the permitted window without duplicating the booking.

scenarios.title: New Slot Is Full During Rescheduling
scenarios.story: The patient’s original appointment and slot reservation are preserved.

scenarios.title: Patient Arrival and Check-in
scenarios.story: Reception verifies the appointment ID and records exactly one successful check-in.

scenarios.title: Unexpected Physician Absence
scenarios.story: The administrator suspends an affected slot and flags bookings for staff handling.

scenarios.title: Patient Arrives Late
scenarios.story: An authorized receptionist applies the hospital exception policy without automatically setting Completed status.

scenarios.title: Doctor Updates Consultation Progress
scenarios.story: Appointment status transitions from Checked-in to In Progress to Completed.

scenarios.title: Notification Provider Outage
scenarios.story: Confirmed appointment remains unchanged while the system queues an outbox retry.

scenarios.title: Unauthorized Appointment Access
scenarios.story: A user cannot read another patient’s appointment; denied attempts may be audited.

scenarios.title: Administrator Reviews Appointment Counts
scenarios.story: An authorized administrator receives a summary by appointment state.

scenarios.title: Patient Registration and Secure Sign-in
scenarios.story: A new patient registers with complete unique contact information, signs in with valid credentials, and invalid or duplicate submissions are rejected.

scenarios.title: Patient Views and Updates Own Profile
scenarios.story: An authenticated patient views their own information, updates an address, and cannot save malformed or duplicated contact details.

scenarios.title: Patient Reviews a Booking and Privacy Boundary
scenarios.story: The owner can list and review appointment details; unrelated patients may not read private bookings.

scenarios.title: Administrator Creates and Audits Physician Slots
scenarios.story: An administrator creates valid slots, is blocked from configuring overlapping slots for the same physician, and preserves an auditable schedule-change record.
